headline: Reddit’s CEO says Google’s AI Mode ‘does not drive traffic’
summary: Reddit CEO states Google's AI search modes fail to drive traffic. Search referrals dropped by over 1 million in October. This echoes traffic problems faced by other publishers.

headline: Patrick Stewart has died at age 86
summary: Actor Patrick Stewart, known for Star Trek and X-Men, passed away at 86. He died at home after a journey with Alzheimer's and Lewy Body Dementia. Stewart was born in 1940 in Mirfield, Yorkshire.

headline: Reddit will force everyone to log in
summary: Reddit is implementing a major change, requiring all users to log in. Currently, users can browse without an account. This shift impacts general access to crowdsourced information.

headline: Rivian’s R2 is officially its best-selling vehicle
summary: Rivian's Q3 2026 earnings show the R2 EV is now its best-selling vehicle. The company reported $2.155 billion in revenue, up 38%. This signals strong performance for the crucial R2 model.

headline: Bethesda Pays Tribute to Patrick Stewart
summary: Bethesda honored Sir Patrick Stewart for his role in Elder Scrolls 4: Oblivion. Fans also recalled his contributions to games like Castlevania. Tributes follow the actor's recent passing.

headline: DCU Batman Casting 'Won't Be Too Long'
summary: James Gunn confirms DC Studios is close to casting the new DCU Batman. The new Batman will be similar in age to David Corenswet's Superman. This signals progress for upcoming DCU projects.

headline: Star Trek Talent Mourn Patrick Stewart
summary: Star Trek colleagues and friends shared tributes to Sir Patrick Stewart. They remembered him as Captain Jean-Luc Picard, who "stood for the best of us." Stewart died at 86 from Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia.

headline: Everything Coming to Peacock in November
summary: Discover all new content arriving on Peacock this November. Prepare for a fresh lineup of movies, shows, and originals. Plan your viewing schedule with the latest additions.

headline: Watch: Life and career of iconic actor Sir Patrick Stewart
summary: Explore the seven-decade career of the iconic actor Sir Patrick Stewart. He earned multiple Emmys, Golden Globes, and a Hollywood Walk of Fame star. Stewart was also knighted by Queen Elizabeth II.

headline: Burnham wants to cut welfare bill
summary: Burnham aims to reduce the welfare bill "as soon as possible." Opponents criticize the Budget for lacking welfare reform details. No timetable for reductions was outlined by the prime minister.

headline: 'Painful' years ahead as living standards fall
summary: Think tanks predict "painful" years ahead for living standards. Budget forecasts indicate growth in living standards will nearly halt. This warns of significant economic challenges.

headline: Audio reveals Spain train crash exchanges
summary: Leaked audio exposes communications before a deadly Spain train crash. One high-speed train reportedly received clearance at normal speed. This occurred despite another train stalling ahead on the tracks.
